title: C# library deployment diagram
description: How the library is used once built: Utv.csproj packs a NuGet package (id Utv, version 0.3.0) whose assembly runs in-process inside the caller's .NET 8 application, with the structural schema embedded. Zone rules are a file or text the application supplies. Nothing in the repository publishes the package to a registry, and no csharp/v* tag exists: it is built from source.

nodes.name: .NET 8 runtime
nodes.description: Whatever machine runs the caller's application; the library reads nothing from it (no clock, zone, locale or tz database).

nodes.name: Caller's application
nodes.description: A .NET 8 program that references Utv and calls it in-process; the example test assembly is one.

artifacts.name: Utv.dll (NuGet package Utv 0.3.0)
artifacts.description: The library assembly, built for net8.0 with the README packed alongside, and schema/utv-1.0.schema.json embedded as a resource. Loaded into the caller's process.

artifacts.name: Zone-rule bundle
artifacts.description: Rule data in the demo-zones.json format, shipped by the application (the example tests copy demo-zones.json next to their assembly) and loaded with ZoneRules.Load(path) or ZoneRules.Parse(text). The library ships no rules.

relationships.description: Runs the application, which loads Utv.dll in-process.
Reads the rule file at the path it chooses, through ZoneRules.Load; nothing else is read.
